description: Cancels a booking by its id and token. The event is removed from the host's calendar. Paid bookings cancelled before `refundableUntil` are refunded in full. Later cancellations get no refund. The event type sets the rules, which get_booking shows: no changes after `changeableUntil` (409 change_too_late), no cancelling when `canCancel` is false (409 cancel_not_allowed, reschedule instead), and a `reason` when `cancelReasonRequired` is true (422 reason_required).

following.description: for a series: also cancel every later meeting

id.description: the booking id from create_booking, or its manageUrl

reason.description: why the invitee cancels, sent to the host
reason.title: maxLength(500)

token.description: the token from create_booking, or the manageUrl

name: cancel_booking_as_invitee
title: Cancel a booking (invitee)
